## <i class="bi bi-cloud-download ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Database access

Data originally provided by:

- **Contact:** Jonathan Sanderman
- **Email:** [jsanderman@woodwellclimate.org](mailto:jsanderman@woodwellclimate.org)
- **Original source:** <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13122321>

**Available files**

| Type | Filename | Link |
|------|----------|------|
| MIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| MIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet) |
| NIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_nir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_nir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| NIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_nir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_nir_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil lab measurements — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil lab measurements — Parquet | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil site metadata — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/Neospectra/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz) |

## <i class="bi bi-geo-alt ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Map

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/Neospectra/README_files/figure-commonmark/map-1.png)

## <i class="bi bi-pin-map ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil site information

- **Coordinates precision:** precise, county, country
- **Sampling depth:** various
- **Geography:** soil taxonomy, soil horizon
- **Variables available (OSSL):** 15 out of 15 — see [Database description](../db-desc.html#panel-soilsite) for full schema
- **Populated columns:** `id.layer_local_c`, `id.kssl.lay_local_txt`, `id.presentation_src_txt`, `id.kssl.smp_local_txt`, `loc.country_src_txt`, `loc.fips.code`, `longitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `latitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `longitude.county_wgs84_dd`, `latitude.county_wgs84_dd`, `pedon.taxa_usda_txt`, `pedon.horizon_usda_txt`, `layer.texture_usda_txt`, `layer.upper.depth_usda_cm`, `layer.lower.depth_usda_cm`

## <i class="bi bi-clipboard-data ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil laboratory information

- **Total samples:** 2,106
- **Properties available (original):** 23
- **Properties standardized (OSSL):** 23 — summarized in **@tbl-soillab-neospectra** below
- **Categories:** physical, chemical, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements
- **Original source:** see [Database access](#database-access)

## <i class="bi bi-soundwave ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> NIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** reflectance
- **Original range:** 1350-2550
- **Instrument:** Neospectra
- **Manufacturer:** SiWare
- **Instrument co-scans:** Not available
- **Scan repeats:** 6
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Original resolution:** 8-16 cm-1
- **Sample preparation:** Oven-dried, Sieved < 2mm
- **Additional info:** Not available
